scope: New-mode original preflight deadline remains anchored to first samples; daemon watcher starts before five-lane connection and is retained by Context. Legacy startup and default sessions unchanged.
ownership: Watch thread captures only Gate and CloseOnDrop, not Context or watcher owner; Context construction failure or last release closes Gate, shuts all endpoints and notifies Condvar before joining the actual thread. Worker panic also closes via guard. No authority work, refresh, retry, or deadline reconstruction occurs in watcher.
limits: Thread join is not a hard-real-time bound. No native/compiler/checker execution; actual startup/caller composition follows separately.
